paper_data.common_inputs: Identical original paper, scientific observations, qualified training labels, frozen task specification and source-matched validation feedback, only after protected manifests are bound.

paper_data_author_code.common_inputs: Exactly the same original scientific inputs, support, metric, target boundary and cumulative budgets as paper_data.
paper_data_author_code.additional_information: Only explicit authenticated original author-code members and qualified dependency closure. No reference predictions, saved models/weights, coefficients or private evaluator outputs.

source_data_evidence.role: Operator source only; raw workspace contains labels and is not candidate-visible by this declaration.

source_exposure: Both conditions share identical original scientific observations, trial partitions and source-permitted training/validation exposure. Only explicit original author code is additional in paper_data_author_code; unfiltered label-bearing workspaces/archives are not participant inputs.
protected_material: Original final held-out outcomes and source/reference prediction/probability/metric bodies.
Source saved fitted models, coefficients and private evaluation policies/output artifacts.
Any label-bearing workspace, notebook output or metadata enabling reconstruction of protected final targets.
evaluation_boundary: Freeze candidate code before operator-only original-fit execution; preserve source-allowed training/validation and preprocessing exposure. Independently join private original outcomes and derive complete source metrics. Exact source-compatible delivery/verification boundaries remain unresolved; this is not a grant of data access.
knowledge_limit: Published paper claims may be intentionally visible, but copying them is not computed reproduction. The no-code arm must not acquire author source or local reference recipes indirectly. Source-code package and dependency audits remain unresolved.
required_before_activation: Authenticate all 17 Figure 3C figure-point/session/animal joins, both conditions and complete six-tone support, including the four-animal claim/Table S1 discrepancy.

Recover published full-precision 34-cell AUC and held-trial prediction vectors and source-equivalent strongest relevant author rerun provenance; no original numeric baseline is established.

Resolve original source-auto pROC levels/orientation and predictive interpretation before evaluator selection. Fixed-positive or corrected AUC is a separate protocol unless exact source equivalence is demonstrated.
Authenticate original PPC feature membership, upstream 1.5-second/20-ms construction, zero-fill semantics and original training-label shuffle procedure/support/output identities.
